executive_summary: Iteration 000040 implements PR metadata enrichment in `approve-prototype`. All 46 tests pass and typecheck is clean. Two minor spec deviations: FR-2 uses `extractPrdSection` (singular) instead of the specified `extractPrdSections`; FR-4 body has extra elements (requirementName preamble, refactor report path). Both deviations appear intentional and do not break any user-facing behaviour.
minor_observations: FR-2: exported helper is `extractPrdSection(content, sectionName)` not `extractPrdSections(markdown): { title, context, goals }` as specified.
FR-4: PR body prepends requirementName and appends 'Refactor report: {path}' before the footer — extra elements not in the spec but confirmed intentional by tests.
US-001-AC02: `extractPrdTitle` matches `# Requirement: ...` specifically, not any `# ` heading. Unlikely to be a problem given the fixed PRD template convention.
conclusions_and_recommendations: The implementation fully delivers iteration 000040 goals. Recommended refactor: (1) add `extractPrdSections(markdown): { title, context, goals }` exported wrapper to `approve-prototype.ts` to satisfy FR-2's contract; (2) keep body structure as-is — extra elements add reviewer value.
